channel.title: Mohsen Niksirat · Engineering Publication
channel.description: Visual engineering essays on AI gateways, spaced repetition, WebAssembly, and local-first tools.

item.title: Designing a Resilient Multi-Provider AI Gateway on Serverless Runtimes
item.description: How 9router and AIDahl pool keys across Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenAI, and OpenRouter with sub-20ms automatic HTTP 429 failover, per-user AES-GCM vaults, and rate-safe Telegram token streaming.

item.title: Beyond Rigid Leitner Boxes: Implementing FSRS in an Offline-First Reader
item.description: Why classic five-box Leitner systems over-schedule reviews, and how Readner models per-card memory stability alongside an integrated PDF reader and semantic WordWeb graph.

item.title: Zero-Backend Developer Tools: Analyzing Repos and Datasets Entirely in the Browser
item.description: Architectural lessons from building Repodest, DataLens, and A11y Inspector so developers can inspect codebases, chart sensitive CSVs, and audit WCAG compliance with zero server uploads.

item.title: 60 FPS Swarm Survival on the Web: Exporting Godot 4 3D Roguelites to WebAssembly
item.description: How Horde Survival 3D sustains hundreds of active 3D enemies, evolving projectile rings, and boss phases inside a browser WASM budget, plus lessons from parallel Unity and Kotlin builds.

item.title: Inspecting the Model Context Protocol: Building a Visual JSON-RPC Workbench
item.description: Inside MCP Studio: turning raw Model Context Protocol JSON Schemas and JSON-RPC 2.0 traffic into an interactive browser IDE for testing agent tools, resources, and prompts.

item.title: Teaching Algorithms with Deterministic Canvas Engines: Inside CodeVis
item.description: How CodeVis packs 49 interactive computer science visualizations, synchronized code stepping, and PNG export cards into a single zero-dependency HTML file.
